subject: LaunchPad cohort sponsorship & package proposal
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@launchpad.co>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood sponsorship for June cohort?

Hi Ben,

Hope you’re well — I run partnerships at LaunchPad Ventures and we’re kicking off a June cohort (6 early-stage companies, 8 weeks). We’re exploring sponsors to provide infrastructure credits and a small committed discount for founders who continue with paid plans. Two quick questions: 1) Can sponsorship credits be applied on top of Redwood’s existing startup program credits (some of our founders may already have startup credits)? 2) Would Redwood consider a pooled sponsorship grant (e.g., $30k in credits) + a short-term volume discount (20% off committed monthly usage for 3–6 months) for cohort graduates?

Attached is our standard sponsorship brief (pdf). Happy to hop on a quick call next week.

—Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Partnerships, LaunchPad Ventures
(415) 555-0142
[sponsorship brief attached: LaunchPad_Sponsorship_Template_v2.pdf]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Park <elaine@launchpad.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood sponsorship for June cohort?

Hi Elaine — great to meet you over email and congrats on the cohort. Short answers up front: 1) In general we don’t deduct sponsor credits from program credits automatically — startup credits remain a separate grant on the founder’s account. We can, however, apply a one-time pooled sponsorship credit to each cohort company’s account if that’s the preference. 2) We can explore a temporary discount for cohort graduates; the size and duration depend on expected committed usage and whether the cohort companies are overlapping with existing promo/partner programs.

Before we lock anything in, can you share estimated monthly usage for a typical company in the cohort (tokens per month or monthly spend range)? Also: do you need credits to be individual allocations or a single pooled code you’ll distribute? I’ve looped Marissa (partnerships ops) and Lauren (commercial lead) to scope approvals and contract flow.

If useful I can propose a default sponsor package we’ve used for similar accelerator partners. Quick availability for a 30-minute call: Tue/Wed 10–2 PST.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
[calendar link stub]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-06T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: LaunchPad sponsorship — usage ask

Ben — quick internal note after scanning Elaine’s brief: ask for a sample cohort roster and expected monthly active users per company. If cohort companies are pre-product or MVP stage, usage may be low; our standard sponsor structure: either (A) pooled credits distributed equally, or (B) per-company allocation with rollover limits. Also tag product for any potential onboarding credits (we sometimes layer 3-month onboarding credits).

For approval band: $30k pooled + up to a 15% committed discount for 4 months is OK margin-wise for a co-marketing partner. 20% for 6 months might need VP sign-off (commercial exceptions). I’ll prepare a quick cost/contra matrix and attach an example usage model (see spreadsheet attached).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Partnerships Ops, Redwood Inference
[attachment: estimated-usage-model.xlsx]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Park <elaine@launchpad.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-06T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LaunchPad cohort sponsorship & next steps

Hi Elaine — thanks for the prompt reply and the brief. Based on similar accelerators here’s a starter proposal for your review: 

- Sponsorship credit pool: $30,000 one-time (to be divided among the 6 companies unless you request per-company allocations). Credits applied as account-level promotional balance, not deducted from existing startup grants.
- Trial onboarding boost: optional 3-month onboarding credit (up to $1,500/company) to accelerate evaluation and demos.
- Graduation discount: 15% off committed monthly usage for 4 months for cohort companies that sign a paid plan within 90 days of graduation.
- Terms: pilot agreement with co-marketing clause and a simple SLAs appendix.

If LaunchPad is hoping for a 20% discount for 6 months we’d need a commercial exception and a short internal review (VP sign-off). Would you prefer pooled credits or per-company allocations? Also: can you provide a roster and an expected monthly spend band (e.g., <$500/mo, $500–2k/mo, >$2k/mo) so we can finalize the discount band?

Happy to get a one-page MOU in DocuSign once you confirm the structure.

—Ben
[Attachment: sponsorship overview stub]

From: Elaine Park <elaine@launchpad.co>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@startupstudio.io>
Date: 2026-05-07T07:29:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LaunchPad cohort sponsorship & next steps

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear options. Quick answers: 
- Roster: I’ll send a confirmed list tomorrow but cohort leans pre-seed / seed (4 founders likely <$500/mo, 2 founders likely in $500–2k/mo band).
- Preference: pooled credits is easiest for our distribution.
- We can accept the 15% / 4-month structure for the pilot.

We are interested in the onboarding boost for a few companies that need help with initial model tuning — would you allow you to earmark up to $6k of the pool for onboarding credits?

I’m happy to sign an MOU — send DocuSign and I’ll get the roster over tomorrow.

—Elaine

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@launchpad.co>
Date: 2026-05-12T15:41:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: LaunchPad sponsorship pilot (LP-2026-004)

Looping back with internal approval note and sending final language to Elaine:

Ben/Marissa — commercial is green for a $30k pooled sponsorship, with up to $6k earmarked for onboarding credits and a 15% graduation discount for 4 months. We will state explicitly that sponsor credits do not stack with startup grants (startup credits remain intact) but both can live on the account and not be auto-deducted. Final MOU to include: allocation schedule, activation window (credits must be used within 12 months), reporting cadence (monthly usage report), and standard co-marketing deliverables.

Elaine — I’ve copied the finalized terms here. I’ll send the MOU via DocuSign and include the checklist link for onboarding.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Commercial Partnerships, Redwood Inference
